description: This file defines the MainActivity class for an Android TV application. It extends FragmentActivity, initializes UI components such as a title TextView, sets the content view, and handles key events for remote control inputs.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity class for Android TV, managing UI setup and remote control key events.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and configures the title text view.

methods.name: onKeyDown
methods.description: Handles key events from the remote control, such as OK, Enter, and Back keys.
